presentation_verification.target: Two-Movie Single-Frame Attract Presentation (Frame 0 LOGOW.SFD + Frame 0 OPENINGW.SFD)
presentation_verification.presentation_type: single-frame attract movie presentation (not playback or streaming)
presentation_verification.notes: Single-frame attract presentation for two retail movies (Frame 0 of LOGOW.SFD and Frame 0 of OPENINGW.SFD) into offscreen target without continuous playback or streaming demux. Regression pins captured via diagnostic readback under 16:9 full-screen edge-to-edge layout (0, 0, 1280, 720) without pillarboxing on Xbox offscreen target, driven through retail movie controller path (play_retail_movie_frame). Verified against independent CPU reference conversion (max delta <= 2). Also verified 4:3 pillarbox destination geometry rule (160, 0, 960, 720) for standard 4:3 N streams without an extra draw call.
